No functions other than `package()` are defined, and `pkgver()` is absent, so no dynamic versioning logic is executed. Since `makepkg --printsrcinfo` only sources the PKGBUILD without running build or package functions, no code that could exfiltrate data or download payloads is triggered. The presence of `SKIP` or missing checksums is irrelevant at this stage, as sources are not downloaded or verified.
</details>
